title: precheck refuses to accept a check that passes before the work as the only check of a goal clause
goal: precheck SP (and check) flags a goal clause whose only mapped check already passes on the base, even when the item's notes say the check pins behaviour, so a clause such as 'a failed link is not swallowed' gets a check that fails until the work is done

run:
import sys, io, tempfile, contextlib, types, json, os
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base as B, bl_land as L
CL = 'a failed link is not swallowed'
PASS = dict(run=['python3', '-c', 'pass'])
FAIL = dict(run=['python3', '-c', 'import sys; sys.exit(1)'])
def run(checks, mapping):
    root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    d = os.path.join(root, B.rel_dir())
    os.makedirs(d)
    it = dict(id='ST-aaaaaaaa', kind='story', status='draft', title='t', sprint='SP-bbbbbbbb', goal=CL, checks=checks,
              notes='the check passes before the work, it pins behaviour', clauses=[dict(clause=CL, check=n) for n in mapping])
    sp = dict(id='SP-bbbbbbbb', kind='sprint', status='planned', title='s')
    for x in (it, sp):
        open(os.path.join(d, x['id'] + '.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps(x))
    buf = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        L.cmd_precheck(B.Backlog(root), types.SimpleNamespace(sprint='SP-bbbbbbbb'))
    return [l for l in buf.getvalue().splitlines() if l.startswith('warning') and CL[:20] in l]
assert run([PASS], [0]), 'only mapped check passes before the work: no clause warning'
assert not run([PASS, FAIL], [0, 1]), 'clause also read by a failing check: no warning'

notes: SP-g2qseu5s retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator. Evidence: BG-h6aqngbp mapped 'a failed link is not swallowed' only to tests.py -k test_census_queue_and_census_groups, noted as passing before the work by design; the SP-g2qseu5s review found that removing the link-failure branch or the held() check leaves it green (parked ST-gdcd6ows).
